name: Emoji
description: Cross-platform emoji, symbol, and kaomoji picker with AI-aware search.
author: Asyar

preferences.name: aiToolEnabled
preferences.title: Enable AI tool
preferences.description: Lets the Asyar chat agent search the emoji catalog via the emoji_find tool.

preferences.name: showKaomoji
preferences.title: Show kaomoji
preferences.description: Include the ¯\_(ツ)_/¯-style kaomoji section in the picker.

preferences.name: shortcodesEnabled
preferences.title: Expand :shortcodes: system-wide
preferences.description: Master switch for the inline replacement. Turn off to silence shortcode expansion everywhere.

commands.name: Emoji & Symbols
commands.description: Pick and insert an emoji, symbol, or kaomoji.

commands.name: Clear Emoji Recents
commands.description: Wipe your recently used emojis and frequency counts.

tools.name: Find emoji
tools.description: Return a small ranked list of emojis matching a natural-language description. Use when the user describes a feeling, situation, or object and you need to suggest emojis — e.g. 'something for being burnt out' or 'celebration'. Returns char, name, and :shortcode: for each match.
